Our factory sits just across the NCR border. SAMAN manufactures steel container offices at our facility in Greater Noida (Vill Jalpura, Tehsil Dadri, 201308) — roughly 40 to 50 kilometres from most of Delhi. That proximity is a real advantage for a Delhi buyer: shorter transit, lower freight, and faster delivery than suppliers shipping units in from distant locations.

Delhi's demand for container offices comes from three directions at once — the dense industrial estates at Okhla, Mayapuri, Bawana, and Narela; the constant construction and infrastructure work across the capital; and the steady stream of government, PWD, and civil projects that need secure, deployable site offices. We supply all of them.

We are an ISO-certified manufacturer, not a dealer reselling units. Explore container office types and price guidance or call us directly with your requirement.

Who Buys a Container Office in Delhi

A container office is a finished steel workspace — built from a refabricated shipping container or a new container-style steel frame — that arrives wired, insulated, and ready to use. No civil construction, no waiting. In Delhi the buyers are clear:

Industrial estate units at Okhla, Mayapuri, Bawana, and Narela use container offices as factory administrative cabins, security posts, and overflow workspace where permanent construction is not justified or not permitted.

Construction and infrastructure contractors building across Delhi need a project manager's site office and a gate security cabin. A site office container for active worksites is the standard solution — lockable, weatherproof, and movable when the project shifts.

Government, PWD, and civil project teams use container offices as deployable field offices for road works, public infrastructure, and municipal projects. These buyers value the unit's mobility and the documentation a certified manufacturer can provide for a procurement file.

Logistics and warehousing operators across Delhi's industrial periphery place container offices at yard entries for dispatch supervision and gate control.

Delhi's Industrial Zones — Where We Deliver

Telling us your delivery zone lets us plan the route and quote accurate freight. We deliver across Delhi, including:

Okhla Industrial Area (PIN 110020): One of Delhi's largest and most established industrial estates in the south-east, dense with manufacturing, printing, and engineering units. Container offices here serve as factory cabins, security posts, and contractor offices.

Bawana Industrial Area (PIN 110039): A large planned industrial zone in north-west Delhi housing relocated and new manufacturing units. New unit setup here drives demand for site offices and security cabins.

Narela Industrial Area (PIN 110040): The northern industrial belt, another major planned estate with manufacturing and logistics operations.

Mayapuri Industrial Area (PIN 110064): A dense west Delhi estate known for engineering, scrap-and-metal trade, and automotive work. Compact container offices fit well in this space-constrained zone.

Outside these zones, we deliver to construction, infrastructure, and government project sites across Delhi wherever a crane or forklift can place the unit.

Sizes and Specifications

Built for a Delhi industrial, construction, or government project site.

Structure: Refabricated ISO shipping container OR new IS 2062 grade steel frame, anti-rust treated and painted
Insulation: PUF panel or rock wool lining — important for Delhi's extreme summers and cold winters
Roofing: Container roof with weather sealing, or sloped GI over-roof
Flooring: Marine plywood, vinyl, or anti-skid steel
Electrical: Wiring, MCB board, LED lights, fan and AC points to your declared load
Windows: Sliding glass with MS safety grille; mesh ventilation
Doors: Container door retained for storage-office combos, or MS/glass entry door

Common sizes for Delhi delivery:

SizeTypical use
10 ftSecurity cabin or single-desk office
20 ftStandard site office — most common
40 ftLarge office, or office + storage combination
20 ft + partitionOffice plus meeting or records room
40 ft modularJoined units for larger workspace

Custom layouts and partitions are built to your site footprint.

Customisation

Everything is built and fitted at our Greater Noida factory before dispatch.

  • Internal partition walls for separate rooms
  • Air conditioner provision — cut-out, bracket, copper sleeve, drain
  • Upgraded insulation for Delhi's summer heat and winter cold
  • Full electrical fit-out with MCB, sockets, LED, fan points
  • Insulated false ceiling for temperature control
  • Attached toilet module with FRP tank and plumbing
  • Pantry counter for longer-stay site offices
  • Anti-corrosion treatment for outdoor durability
  • Exterior paint and department or company branding panel

Why Buy From SAMAN

We manufacture our own container offices at Greater Noida — most Delhi suppliers are dealers reselling units with a markup.

  • ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management (E20250218645)
  • ISO 14001:2015 Environmental Management (E20250218646)
  • ISO 45001:2018 Occupational Health & Safety (E20250218647)
  • NSIC: NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207
  • DPIIT: DIPP56005
  • GST (North): 09ABBCS7101B1ZT

Structural frame warranty: 5 years. Finishing: 1–2 years. Engineered service life: 20–25 years. Over 500 projects since 2009.

For government, PWD, and procurement buyers who require vendor documentation for a tender or supply order, we provide ISO certificate copies, NSIC registration, DPIIT recognition, and GST papers with your order.

Price Factors

No fixed published price — every container office is built to specification. Cost depends on:

  • Converted shipping container vs new steel-frame build
  • Size (10 ft / 20 ft / 40 ft)
  • Insulation and climate-protection level
  • Electrical and AC fit-out
  • Partition, toilet, and pantry additions
  • Anti-corrosion treatment for long-term outdoor use

Because we dispatch from Greater Noida — next to the NCR — freight to a Delhi address is lower than from suppliers shipping in from far away. Send your size and use for a written quotation with full breakup within 24 hours.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the price of a container office in Delhi?

Price depends on size, whether it is a converted shipping container or a new steel-frame build, the insulation and AC fit-out, and any partition or toilet additions. A basic 20 ft unit costs less than a 40 ft fully-fitted office. Because our factory is in Greater Noida, next to the NCR, freight to Delhi is lower than from distant suppliers. Call +91 87960 39938 for a written quotation with full breakup within 24 hours.

Can you deliver a container office to Okhla, Bawana, or Narela industrial areas?

Yes. We deliver to Okhla (PIN 110020), Bawana (110039), Narela (110040), Mayapuri (110064), and all Delhi industrial, construction, and government project addresses. For industrial estate or government site deliveries needing gate-pass or entry authorisation, share the procedure when you order and we coordinate the delivery vehicle with your site.

How quickly can you deliver to Delhi from your Greater Noida factory?

Standard sizes are typically ready in 7–12 working days from order confirmation. Because our factory is only 40 to 50 km from most of Delhi, transit is usually same-day once dispatched. Custom fit-out with AC, partition, and toilet adds a few working days to production.

Do you supply container offices for PWD and government civil projects in Delhi?

Yes. We supply deployable site offices and security cabins for government, PWD, and municipal civil projects across Delhi. We provide the vendor documentation — ISO certificates, NSIC registration, DPIIT recognition, GST papers — needed for a tender or procurement file. Mention the documentation requirement when you place the order.

Call or Send an Enquiry

For a container office in Delhi — manufactured by SAMAN, delivered from Greater Noida:

+91 87960 39938 | +91 97089 89937

Call or WhatsApp. Same working day response. Include your size, use, and delivery zone for a complete quotation without a follow-up call.
